note: First version: core://Button with its style and size (decision one-button-node)

component.doc: A button: one of the renderer's fixed faces, so buttons side by side match. style is Primary (filled with the accent: the screen's main action), Secondary (outlined: an action beside the main one), Tonal (the accent's tint) or Text (accent text alone); size is Regular (40 dp tall) or Small (32 dp). on_click is any intent (action.sequence, action.confirm, action.mutation.optimistic, ...). Use it, or core://Button itself, for every button: never a core://Tappable over a Box.
